# coarsen guarded

Marks a property as PRECISION-BEARING for disclosure control (#282, CONSTITUTION P10): when a projection branch reads this property of a subject, the mapping compiler injects a guard so the subject's precise values never pass a gmeow:coarsenTo mark — the coarse form is published only by a profile's explicit coarsening branch. Ontology-derived, never a hand list: annotating a new precise-value property extends every generated projection's guards on the next regenerate.
